# meowyrender sample applications
if(MEOWY_VISIONOS)
    add_executable(visionos_showcase MACOSX_BUNDLE visionos/main.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(visionos_showcase PRIVATE meowyrender::meowyrender)
    set_target_properties(visionos_showcase PROPERTIES
        MACOSX_BUNDLE_INFO_PLIST "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/visionos/Info.plist"
        XCODE_ATTRIBUTE_PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER "com.meowy.meowyrender.showcase"
        XCODE_ATTRIBUTE_TARGETED_DEVICE_FAMILY "7"
        XCODE_ATTRIBUTE_CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED "NO")
    return()
endif()
add_executable(showcase showcase/main.cpp)
add_executable(quickstart quickstart.cpp)
add_executable(stormchasing stormchasing.cpp)
target_link_libraries(quickstart PRIVATE meowyrender::meowyrender)
target_link_libraries(showcase PRIVATE meowyrender::meowyrender)
target_link_libraries(stormchasing PRIVATE meowyrender::meowyrender)
set_target_properties(stormchasing PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin)
# Dear ImGui demo (only built when the library was compiled with ImGui support).
if(MEOWY_HAVE_IMGUI)
    add_executable(imgui_demo imgui_demo.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(imgui_demo PRIVATE meowyrender::meowyrender)
    set_target_properties(imgui_demo PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin)
endif()
target_compile_features(showcase PRIVATE cxx_std_26)
target_compile_definitions(showcase PRIVATE MEOWY_SAMPLE_ASSETS="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/assets")
add_executable(render_checks render_checks.cpp)
target_link_libraries(render_checks PRIVATE meowyrender::meowyrender)
set_target_properties(render_checks PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin)
add_executable(backend_checks backend_checks.cpp)
target_link_libraries(backend_checks PRIVATE meowyrender::meowyrender)
set_target_properties(backend_checks PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin)
if(BUILD_TESTING)
    # raylib 6.0 linkage conformance target (proves mapped symbols resolve).
    add_executable(raylib6_conformance ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../tests/compat/conformance_target.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(raylib6_conformance PRIVATE meowyrender::meowyrender)
    set_target_properties(raylib6_conformance PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin)
    add_test(NAME raylib6_conformance COMMAND raylib6_conformance)
    set_tests_properties(raylib6_conformance PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 30)
    # Static conformance gate: every raylib manifest function must be declared,
    # arity-compatible, and a REAL (non-stub) definition -- unless explicitly
    # listed as platform_unavailable / intentional_noop in parity_overrides.json.
    find_package(Python3 COMPONENTS Interpreter)
    if(Python3_Interpreter_FOUND)
        add_test(NAME raylib6_conformance_static
            COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE}
                    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../tests/compat/conformance_check.py)
        set_tests_properties(raylib6_conformance_static PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 60)
    endif()
    # Runtime backend-selection tests. The pure-logic case runs everywhere; the
    # window-backed and env-driven fallback cases exercise selection/fallback.
    add_executable(backend_selection_checks backend_selection_checks.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(backend_selection_checks PRIVATE meowyrender::meowyrender)
    add_test(NAME backend_selection_logic COMMAND backend_selection_checks logic)
    add_test(NAME backend_selection_auto COMMAND backend_selection_checks auto)
    add_test(NAME backend_selection_reject_after_init COMMAND backend_selection_checks reject-after-init)
    set_tests_properties(backend_selection_logic backend_selection_auto backend_selection_reject_after_init
        PROPERTIES WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR} TIMEOUT 60 RUN_SERIAL TRUE)
    # Explicit selection: one test per compiled backend.
    if(MEOWY_HAVE_OPENGL)
        add_test(NAME backend_selection_explicit_opengl COMMAND backend_selection_checks explicit opengl)
        set_tests_properties(backend_selection_explicit_opengl PROPERTIES WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR} TIMEOUT 60 RUN_SERIAL TRUE)
    endif()
    if(MEOWY_HAVE_METAL)
        add_test(NAME backend_selection_explicit_metal COMMAND backend_selection_checks explicit metal)
        set_tests_properties(backend_selection_explicit_metal PROPERTIES WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR} TIMEOUT 60 RUN_SERIAL TRUE)
    endif()
    if(MEOWY_HAVE_VULKAN)
        add_test(NAME backend_selection_explicit_vulkan COMMAND backend_selection_checks explicit vulkan)
        set_tests_properties(backend_selection_explicit_vulkan PROPERTIES WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR} TIMEOUT 60 RUN_SERIAL TRUE)
    endif()
    # Fallback: force the platform's first-preferred backend to fail; selection
    # must fall back to another compiled backend (only meaningful when >=2 exist).
    if((MEOWY_HAVE_METAL AND MEOWY_HAVE_OPENGL) OR (MEOWY_HAVE_VULKAN AND MEOWY_HAVE_OPENGL) OR (MEOWY_HAVE_METAL AND MEOWY_HAVE_VULKAN))
        add_test(NAME backend_selection_fallback COMMAND backend_selection_checks fallback)
        if(APPLE)
            set(MEOWY_FALLBACK_FAIL "MEOWY_FORCE_BACKEND_FAIL=metal")
        else()
            set(MEOWY_FALLBACK_FAIL "MEOWY_FORCE_BACKEND_FAIL=vulkan")
        endif()
        set_tests_properties(backend_selection_fallback PROPERTIES
            WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR} TIMEOUT 60 RUN_SERIAL TRUE
            ENVIRONMENT "${MEOWY_FALLBACK_FAIL}")
    endif()
    # All backends forced to fail: InitWindow must throw (no crash/leak).
    add_test(NAME backend_selection_allfail COMMAND backend_selection_checks allfail)
    set_tests_properties(backend_selection_allfail PROPERTIES
        WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR} TIMEOUT 60 RUN_SERIAL TRUE
        ENVIRONMENT "MEOWY_FORCE_BACKEND_FAIL=metal,vulkan,opengl")
    foreach(check audio_checks asset_checks image_checks application_checks shader_value_checks msaa_checks rcore_util_checks shapes_checks textures_util_checks models_util_checks)
        add_executable(${check} ${check}.cpp)
        target_link_libraries(${check} PRIVATE meowyrender::meowyrender)
        add_test(NAME ${check} COMMAND ${check})
        set_tests_properties(${check} PROPERTIES WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR} TIMEOUT 60 RUN_SERIAL TRUE)
        if(MEOWY_HAVE_METAL)
            set_tests_properties(${check} PROPERTIES ENVIRONMENT "MTL_DEBUG_LAYER=1;MTL_SHADER_VALIDATION=1")
        endif()
    endforeach()
    set_tests_properties(audio_checks PROPERTIES ENVIRONMENT "")
    add_test(NAME audio_codec_checks COMMAND audio_checks
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/assets/test-tone.ogg"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/assets/test-tone.mp3"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/assets/test-tone.flac")
    set_tests_properties(audio_codec_checks PROPERTIES WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR} TIMEOUT 60 RUN_SERIAL TRUE)
    # Audit UpdateMusicStream as an architectural no-op: playback progresses
    # without it, repeated calls harmless, pause/resume/seek/loop/cleanup correct.
    add_executable(music_lifecycle_checks music_lifecycle_checks.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(music_lifecycle_checks PRIVATE meowyrender::meowyrender)
    add_test(NAME music_lifecycle_checks COMMAND music_lifecycle_checks
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/assets/test-tone.flac")
    set_tests_properties(music_lifecycle_checks PROPERTIES WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR} TIMEOUT 60 RUN_SERIAL TRUE ENVIRONMENT "")
    # Behavioral checks for audio DSP processors / stream callback + gesture pinch.
    add_executable(audio_processor_checks audio_processor_checks.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(audio_processor_checks PRIVATE meowyrender::meowyrender)
    add_test(NAME audio_processor_checks COMMAND audio_processor_checks)
    set_tests_properties(audio_processor_checks PROPERTIES WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR} TIMEOUT 60 RUN_SERIAL TRUE ENVIRONMENT "")
    if(MEOWY_HAVE_METAL)
        set_tests_properties(audio_processor_checks PROPERTIES ENVIRONMENT "MTL_DEBUG_LAYER=1;MTL_SHADER_VALIDATION=1")
    endif()
    # Gamepad rumble: mapping + parameter conversion + lifecycle. Uses internal
    # platform.hpp helpers, so it needs the src include dir and the SDL macro
    # mirrored from the library. Desktop (GLFW) only; not built on visionOS.
    if(NOT MEOWY_VISIONOS)
        add_executable(gamepad_rumble_checks gamepad_rumble_checks.cpp)
        target_link_libraries(gamepad_rumble_checks PRIVATE meowyrender::meowyrender)
        target_include_directories(gamepad_rumble_checks PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../src)
        target_compile_features(gamepad_rumble_checks PRIVATE cxx_std_26)
        if(MEOWY_HAVE_SDL_GAMEPAD)
            target_compile_definitions(gamepad_rumble_checks PRIVATE MEOWY_HAVE_SDL_GAMEPAD=1)
            target_link_libraries(gamepad_rumble_checks PRIVATE SDL3::SDL3)
        endif()
        add_test(NAME gamepad_rumble_checks COMMAND gamepad_rumble_checks)
        set_tests_properties(gamepad_rumble_checks PROPERTIES WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR} TIMEOUT 60 RUN_SERIAL TRUE)
        if(MEOWY_HAVE_METAL)
            set_tests_properties(gamepad_rumble_checks PROPERTIES ENVIRONMENT "MTL_DEBUG_LAYER=1;MTL_SHADER_VALIDATION=1")
        endif()
    endif()
    add_executable(transparency_checks transparency_checks.cpp)
    target_compile_features(transparency_checks PRIVATE cxx_std_26)
    target_link_libraries(transparency_checks PRIVATE meowyrender::meowyrender)
    add_test(NAME transparency_checks COMMAND transparency_checks)
    set_tests_properties(transparency_checks PROPERTIES WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR} TIMEOUT 60 RUN_SERIAL TRUE)
    if(MEOWY_HAVE_METAL)
        set_tests_properties(transparency_checks PROPERTIES ENVIRONMENT "MTL_DEBUG_LAYER=1;MTL_SHADER_VALIDATION=1")
    endif()
    add_executable(cascaded_shadow_checks cascaded_shadow_checks.cpp)
    target_compile_features(cascaded_shadow_checks PRIVATE cxx_std_26)
    target_link_libraries(cascaded_shadow_checks PRIVATE meowyrender::meowyrender)
    add_test(NAME cascaded_shadow_checks COMMAND cascaded_shadow_checks)
    set_tests_properties(cascaded_shadow_checks PROPERTIES WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR} TIMEOUT 60 RUN_SERIAL TRUE)
    if(MEOWY_HAVE_METAL)
        set_tests_properties(cascaded_shadow_checks PROPERTIES ENVIRONMENT "MTL_DEBUG_LAYER=1;MTL_SHADER_VALIDATION=1")
    endif()
    add_executable(material_checks material_checks.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(material_checks PRIVATE meowyrender::meowyrender)
    add_test(NAME material_checks COMMAND material_checks)
    set_tests_properties(material_checks PROPERTIES WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR} TIMEOUT 60 RUN_SERIAL TRUE)
    add_executable(ibl_precompute_checks ibl_precompute_checks.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(ibl_precompute_checks PRIVATE meowyrender::meowyrender)
    add_test(NAME ibl_precompute_checks COMMAND ibl_precompute_checks)
    set_tests_properties(ibl_precompute_checks PROPERTIES WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR} TIMEOUT 60 RUN_SERIAL TRUE)
    add_executable(cubemap_checks cubemap_checks.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(cubemap_checks PRIVATE meowyrender::meowyrender)
    add_test(NAME cubemap_checks COMMAND cubemap_checks)
    set_tests_properties(cubemap_checks PROPERTIES WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR} TIMEOUT 60 RUN_SERIAL TRUE)
    add_executable(stereo_checks stereo_checks.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(stereo_checks PRIVATE meowyrender::meowyrender)
    add_test(NAME stereo_checks COMMAND stereo_checks)
    set_tests_properties(stereo_checks PROPERTIES WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR} TIMEOUT 60 RUN_SERIAL TRUE)
    if(MEOWY_HAVE_VULKAN)
        add_executable(vulkan_shader_checks vulkan_shader_checks.cpp)
        target_link_libraries(vulkan_shader_checks PRIVATE meowyrender::meowyrender)
        add_test(NAME vulkan_shader_checks COMMAND vulkan_shader_checks)
        set_tests_properties(vulkan_shader_checks PROPERTIES WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR} TIMEOUT 60 RUN_SERIAL TRUE)
        # Isolated shadow depth-pass rendering regression. Reaches into internal
        # headers to drive the shadow pass directly and read the offscreen R32F
        # map back to host (Vulkan-only diagnostic hook). It reports evidence
        # about whether occluder fragments are stored under the active driver.
        add_executable(vulkan_shadow_regression vulkan_shadow_regression.cpp)
        target_link_libraries(vulkan_shadow_regression PRIVATE meowyrender::meowyrender)
        target_include_directories(vulkan_shadow_regression PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../src)
        target_compile_features(vulkan_shadow_regression PRIVATE cxx_std_26)
        add_test(NAME vulkan_shadow_regression COMMAND vulkan_shadow_regression)
        set_tests_properties(vulkan_shadow_regression PROPERTIES WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR} TIMEOUT 60 RUN_SERIAL TRUE)
    endif()
    add_executable(offscreen_checks offscreen_checks.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(offscreen_checks PRIVATE meowyrender::meowyrender)
    set_target_properties(offscreen_checks PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin)
    add_test(NAME offscreen_checks COMMAND offscreen_checks)
    set_tests_properties(offscreen_checks PROPERTIES WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR} TIMEOUT 60 RUN_SERIAL TRUE)
    add_executable(animation_checks animation_checks.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(animation_checks PRIVATE meowyrender::meowyrender)
    target_compile_definitions(animation_checks PRIVATE MEOWY_TEST_ASSETS="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/assets")
    set_target_properties(animation_checks PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin)
    add_test(NAME animation_checks COMMAND animation_checks)
    set_tests_properties(animation_checks PROPERTIES WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR} TIMEOUT 60 RUN_SERIAL TRUE)
    add_executable(gltf_checks gltf_checks.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(gltf_checks PRIVATE meowyrender::meowyrender)
    set_target_properties(gltf_checks PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin)
    add_test(NAME gltf_checks COMMAND gltf_checks)
    set_tests_properties(gltf_checks PROPERTIES WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR} TIMEOUT 60 RUN_SERIAL TRUE)
    if(MEOWY_HAVE_METAL)
        set_tests_properties(animation_checks offscreen_checks stereo_checks cubemap_checks material_checks ibl_precompute_checks gltf_checks PROPERTIES ENVIRONMENT "MTL_DEBUG_LAYER=1;MTL_SHADER_VALIDATION=1")
    endif()
    add_test(NAME backend_checks COMMAND backend_checks)
    set_tests_properties(backend_checks PROPERTIES WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR} TIMEOUT 60 RUN_SERIAL TRUE)
    if(NOT MEOWY_BACKEND STREQUAL "Vulkan")
        add_test(NAME render_checks COMMAND render_checks)
        add_test(NAME render_checks_msaa COMMAND render_checks)
        set_tests_properties(render_checks_msaa PROPERTIES WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR} TIMEOUT 60 RUN_SERIAL TRUE ENVIRONMENT "MEOWY_TEST_MSAA=1")
        set_tests_properties(render_checks PROPERTIES WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR} TIMEOUT 60 RUN_SERIAL TRUE)
        if(MEOWY_HAVE_METAL)
            set_tests_properties(backend_checks render_checks PROPERTIES ENVIRONMENT "MTL_DEBUG_LAYER=1;MTL_SHADER_VALIDATION=1")
            set_tests_properties(render_checks_msaa PROPERTIES ENVIRONMENT "MEOWY_TEST_MSAA=1;MTL_DEBUG_LAYER=1;MTL_SHADER_VALIDATION=1")
        endif()
    else()
        add_test(NAME render_checks COMMAND render_checks)
        set_tests_properties(render_checks PROPERTIES WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR} TIMEOUT 60 RUN_SERIAL TRUE)
        add_test(NAME render_checks_msaa COMMAND render_checks)
        set_tests_properties(render_checks_msaa PROPERTIES WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR} TIMEOUT 60 RUN_SERIAL TRUE ENVIRONMENT "MEOWY_TEST_MSAA=1")
    endif()
endif()

# On macOS a GUI app should be a bundle for proper window focus; keep it simple
# as a console executable here so it prints backend/log info to the terminal.
set_target_properties(showcase PROPERTIES
    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin)
